title.value: Run competitor analysis with browser agents for solopreneurs

introduction.value: The poster tested browser agents on daily solopreneur workflows and got a competitor analysis in about three minutes, though ChatGPT agent was slow, got stuck and hallucinated.

method.value: The poster compared several browser agents on solopreneur tasks including finding decision makers, sourcing LinkedIn candidates, summarizing WhatsApp chats, finding GitHub developers, and analyzing competitor content. They report Claude Chrome Control, Manus, ChatGPT agent, and raw browser use all failed or got stuck, while 100x bot was the only one that consistently completed the workflows; no step-by-step for the competitor-analysis run is given in the thread.

outcome.value: For competitor analysis, the stated result was a completed run in about three minutes. Across all tested workflows, the poster says 100x bot handled 1,000+ cycles without breaking, while ChatGPT agent was slow, got stuck, and hallucinated.

notes.value: The main catch is that this Reddit post gives timing and comparisons, but not the exact prompt, inputs, or workflow needed to reproduce the competitor-analysis setup.

Run competitor analysis with browser agents for solopreneurs
The poster tested browser agents on daily solopreneur workflows and got a competitor analysis in about three minutes, though ChatGPT agent was slow, got stuck and hallucinated.

ChatGPT Agent
What they did
The poster compared several browser agents on solopreneur tasks including finding decision makers, sourcing LinkedIn candidates, summarizing WhatsApp chats, finding GitHub developers, and analyzing competitor content. They report Claude Chrome Control, Manus, ChatGPT agent, and raw browser use all failed or got stuck, while 100x bot was the only one that consistently completed the workflows; no step-by-step for the competitor-analysis run is given in the thread.
How it went
For competitor analysis, the stated result was a completed run in about three minutes. Across all tested workflows, the poster says 100x bot handled 1,000+ cycles without breaking, while ChatGPT agent was slow, got stuck, and hallucinated.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that this Reddit post gives timing and comparisons, but not the exact prompt, inputs, or workflow needed to reproduce the competitor-analysis setup.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
I run [type of business] aimed at [audience]. Find my top [number, e.g. 5] competitors, then visit their websites and compare pricing, positioning, key features and target customers. Finish with a comparison table, three gaps I could exploit, and a source link for each fact. Mark any detail you could not verify instead of guessing.
